```cypher
MATCH (p_molstructure:Plugin {component: 'atto_molstructure'})<-[:MAINTAINS]-(m:Maintainer)
MATCH (p_tinymce:Plugin)
WHERE p_tinymce.component STARTS WITH 'tinymce_'
OPTIONAL MATCH (p_tinymce)<-[:MAINTAINS]-(m_tinymce:Maintainer)
WITH p_tinymce, COLLECT(DISTINCT m.display_name) AS molstructure_maintainers, COLLECT(DISTINCT m_tinymce.display_name) AS tinymce_maintainers
RETURN p_tinymce.component, p_tinymce.name, molstructure_maintainers, tinymce_maintainers
LIMIT 100
```
